name: Secret Keeper’s Circlet

Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Once a day, set a trigger; if it happens within a day, you forget everything since you set it.
text: Once per dawn, as a Magic action while wearing this circlet, you can name a trigger. If it happens within the next 24 hours, you forget everything from setting it until it happened, and only a Wish restores those memories.

params.text: sets a trigger for your memory to wipe
